text: In 2021, the property experienced tree-cover loss affecting **81.3 hectares** (2.23% of the total area). This area was primarily planted forest (68.1 ha, species *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), with no native forest involved. An additional **37.3 hectares** of small patches (<0.5 ha) were lost but not counted as part of the main event. The JRC 2020 data corroborated 98% of the affected area as forested in 2020. The loss met the minimum event size (0.5 ha) and tree-cover threshold (30%).
